summary: Tested the 2 critical changes on StockAuto: (1) Repasse privacy locks, (2) regional cleanup (remove João Pessoa/PB, focus Campo Grande/MS). BLOCKER FOUND FIRST: the whole SPA rendered a white screen (body length 0) because /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx used useNavigate() without importing it AND still rendered <RegionSelector /> after the component was deleted -> 'useNavigate is not defined' pageerror inside <Layout>, crashing every route for every user. I applied the in-scope fix (added useNavigate to the react-router-dom import, removed the orphan <RegionSelector /> JSX) and then ran the full suite. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_repasse_privacy_regional.py (13 tests) — GET /api/vehicles?ad_type=repasse -> 403 PT-BR (also 403 for admin), GET /api/vehicles -> 200 with zero repasse leakage, GET /api/repasse/vehicles anon -> 401, dealer plan=avulso active -> 403 'plano Loja', dealer plan=loja pending -> 403 'liberada', dealer plan=loja active -> 200, admin -> 200 bypass, sitemap.xml has no 'joao-pessoa' and has 'seminovos-campo-grande-ms', robots.txt + /api/seo/home clean. Full regression: 45 passed / 7 skipped / 0 failed. Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080): homepage loads with Campo Grande copy and no 'Pessoa' anywhere; header-region-selector absent; nav-repasse absent for anon; footer-city-joao-pessoa absent; footer-city-campo-grande present; socials -> instagram.com/stockautobr + facebook.com/stockautobr; /seminovos-joao-pessoa-pb -> ComingSoon 'Página não encontrada'; /seminovos-campo-grande-ms H1 = 'Veículos e Repasses em Campo Grande - MS'; /repasse anon -> redirect /login; admin login -> nav-repasse visible + Hub renders; dealer plan=loja -> nav-repasse visible + Hub renders. Zero page errors after the fix.

minor.issue: Asymmetric privacy lock: ad_type='repasse' creation has NO plan_code check (only require_dealer + status==active). A dealer on plan 'avulso' can auto-publish (status=active, no moderation) into the Repasse Hub that GET /api/repasse/vehicles forbids them from reading. Add require_repasse_access(user) when body.ad_type=='repasse'.
Only flags the dealer's vehicles as status='deleted'; documents are never removed, so orphan vehicles accumulate forever (found 12 orphans with no matching dealer_id; I purged them).

Environment DB currently holds only the admin user — 0 dealers and 0 vehicles (SEED_DEMO_DATA is not set in backend/.env so seed_demo/seed_campo_grande are skipped). Public site therefore renders empty listings, and /app/memory/test_credentials.md still advertises 5 active dealer accounts that no longer exist.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY ME (blocker): 'useNavigate is not defined' + '<RegionSelector /> is not defined' -> React crash inside <Layout>, blank page on every route. Root cause: the RegionSelector removal deleted the component + its useNavigate import but left both usages behind.

nav-repasse is rendered for ANY logged-in dealer (user.role === 'dealer'), including plan_code='avulso' dealers who are blocked by the backend with 403. Gate on user.plan_code === 'loja' || role === 'admin', or show an upgrade CTA.

integration_issues.issue: Backend correctly returns 403 'Acesso ao Hub de Repasse é exclusivo do plano Loja', but Repasse.jsx swallows it in a bare .catch(() => { setItems([]); setTotal(0); }) with no error state. The avulso dealer sees the full Hub chrome + '0 OFERTAS NO HUB / Nenhuma oferta de repasse no momento' — a misleading empty state instead of the plan-upgrade message. Add error state handling (403 -> upgrade screen, 401 -> login).

issues: Spec asked for title containing 'Campo Grande - MS'. public/index.html is correct, but the SEO component overrides the runtime title to 'StockAuto — As melhores ofertas de Campo Grande, MS' (comma, no ' - MS'). No 'João Pessoa'/'PB' leakage, so this is cosmetic/SEO-consistency only.
CATEGORIA and UF use native browser <select> elements instead of the shadcn Select component used elsewhere — inconsistent look and no styling of the option list.
UF dropdown still lists all 27 UFs including PB while the product is scoped to MS only; consider restricting or keeping MS first.
Hub hero right half is empty black space at 1920px; the empty-state block sits high leaving a large blank area above the footer.

action_items: REVIEW my blocker fix in Layout.jsx (useNavigate import + removed orphan <RegionSelector />) — run `yarn lint`/eslint before shipping any component-removal refactor; eslint caught both errors instantly.
Hide nav-repasse from dealers whose plan_code !== 'loja' (or render an upgrade CTA instead of a dead link).
Add error/403 handling to Repasse.jsx (and RepasseDetail.jsx) so blocked dealers see the 'exclusivo do plano Loja' upgrade message instead of a fake empty hub.
Enforce require_repasse_access() inside POST/PUT /api/dealer/vehicles when ad_type=='repasse' so avulso dealers cannot publish into the Hub.

Decide on demo data: DB has 0 dealers/0 vehicles (SEED_DEMO_DATA unset) so the public site is empty; either set SEED_DEMO_DATA=true for preview or update /app/memory/test_credentials.md which lists 5 non-existent dealer accounts.
Optional: align the runtime homepage title with 'Campo Grande - MS' for SEO consistency with index.html.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx regression proves there is no pre-commit lint gate; both failures were plain eslint no-undef/jsx-no-undef errors that made the entire app unusable.
Repasse.jsx uses bare `.catch(() => setItems([]))` — swallowing 401/403 into an empty list is a privacy-UX defect: users cannot tell 'no data' from 'no access'.
server.py is now 1572 lines; split into routers (public.py, dealer.py, admin.py, repasse.py, seo.py) plus seed.py.

require_repasse_access() is only applied on the two GET /repasse endpoints; the write path (dealer_create_vehicle with ad_type='repasse', which auto-publishes with status='active' and no moderation) bypasses the plan gate entirely.

Repasse.jsx hardcodes `const params = { uf: 'MS' }` before merging query params — acceptable now but couples the page to a single region; move it to a shared region constant used by App.js/Listing/Repasse.

success_rate.backend: 100% (45 passed, 7 skipped, 0 failed; 13/13 new privacy+regional tests pass)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 9 requested UI checks pass — but only after fixing the white-screen blocker; 2 gaps remain for avulso dealers

All removed via DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}; also purged 12 orphan vehicle docs left behind by admin user deletion. DB now: 1 user (admin), 0 vehicles.

WARNING: the 5 dealer accounts listed in /app/memory/test_credentials.md do NOT exist in the DB — dealers must be registered + activated on the fly (POST /api/auth/register then PUT /api/admin/users/{id} {status:'active', plan_code:'loja'|'avulso'}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -q` (52 tests). New file tests/test_repasse_privacy_regional.py covers repasse privacy + regional cleanup and self-provisions dealers (helpers _register_dealer/_activate) with autouse cleanup. Seed-dependent tests in backend_test.py (TestSeedCampoGrande, TestPublic dealers/vehicles) now pytest.skip when SEED_DEMO_DATA is off — re-enable assertions if demo data is seeded. Repasse Hub is empty (0 repasse ads) so listing content itself was not verified with real cards; to test cards, create a dealer with plan_code=loja and POST /api/dealer/vehicles with ad_type='repasse' + fipe_price + price + year_make + year_model (year_make is required, 422 otherwise) — it auto-publishes with status='active'. Frontend testids: NAV.* in src/constants/testIds, nav-repasse / nav-logout / login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button, footer-city-campo-grande, footer-social-instagram|facebook, footer-cities-section.
rca_of_the_issue: White screen RCA: the 'remove RegionSelector' change deleted the RegionSelector component from Layout.jsx but left (a) `const navigate = useNavigate()` while the import line had been reduced to `import { Link, NavLink } from 'react-router-dom'`, and (b) the `<RegionSelector />` element in the anonymous-user branch. React threw 'useNavigate is not defined' during <Layout> render — Layout wraps every route, and there is no ErrorBoundary, so document.body was empty on all pages while <title> still rendered from index.html (masking the failure from naive title-only checks). Fix: restore useNavigate in the import and delete the orphan JSX. Mitigation: add an ErrorBoundary around <Routes> so a component crash degrades gracefully, and run eslint in CI.
